title: Evaluation & scorecard
description: Measured quality of an exercise (T1-T6) and the 13-dimension AI-readiness scorecard. A metric that cannot be computed is shown as “not computed”, never as zero.
pick: Choose an exercise to see its metrics.
scorecardHint: Criteria are answered from documents and the run, independently of the gap list. A dimension with no assessed criterion is “not assessed”: it is not a score of 0.
radarLabel: Radar chart of the scorecard dimensions
judgeHint: The AI judge proposes an answer per criterion from the exercise facts (ledger events, documents), never from the gaps. Every answer must cite its evidence, otherwise it stays “not assessed”. Your own answers are never overwritten.
judgeDone: AI assessment finished: answers to review.
toReviewHint: Check them in the table, correct if needed, then validate with your name.
